$comment: REAL DATA, transcribed by hand from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFOZ (AIP France, AMDT 11/24, chart dated 2024-10-03).
Only facts are recorded here; the charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed.
Runway geometry, taxiways, parking and frequencies also come from the simulator at run time; this file holds
what the simulator does not know: services, circuit rules and reporting points.
Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Orléans-Saint-Denis-de-l'Hôtel

service.atsHours: AFIS MON-FRI except public holidays 0730-1100, 1330-1700 (UTC in winter, local time minus 1 h in summer); extension on PPR

circuit.southCircuit: specific circuit south of the runway, only with the aerodrome operator's authorisation during ATS hours and with no gliding in progress
circuit.lowHeightTraining: training in low-height pattern below 500 ft AAL prohibited

notes: On arrival, report at least 3 minutes before overhead: glider winching may be announced on the air-air frequency.
Outside AFIS hours, listen to the frequency for at least 2 minutes before entering the circuit (winching).
During announced winching, reconnaissance of the site only above 2800 ft AMSL.
Simultaneous landings or take-offs on the two adjacent runways are strictly prohibited.
Landing runway 05: do not vacate via taxiway C. Landing runway 23: do not vacate via taxiways F and A.
Aerobatics (NR 6429) on the 05/23 axis, 2000-4000 ft AMSL; parachuting (NR 254) up to FL135 by day.
